There are no truly secure email clients because SMTP is not a secure protocol. Even with SSMTP, it requires your public cert to be installed on everyone else's clients.

The best you can get is to run your own email server and encrypt the drive. But, even then, if you send an email to someone, it will be in clear text, unless you use SSMTP and they have your public cert already.
